title: Initialize workspace and copy templates
acceptance: workspace目录存在且模板文件齐全（含 error sinks: QUALITY_GATE/RUN_ERRORS）

title: Draft kickoff questions + seed queries
acceptance: DECISIONS含C0问题块；queries.md 含非空关键词

title: Collect candidate papers (multi-route) and normalize metadata
acceptance: 候选池满足 profile：course_paper>=200；survey/deep>=1200；每条含 title/authors/year/url + 稳定标识（arxiv_id/doi）+ provenance；abstract 模式下 abstract 缺失率应显著低于“多数缺失”；retrieval_report.md 记录来源/覆盖桶/缺失字段统计

title: Dedupe+rank and produce core set
acceptance: 去重后重复率<2%；dedup 池同时 >=200 且 >=core_size*4；core_set 行数满足 queries.md:core_size（course_paper=48；survey/deep=300）

title: Build taxonomy (2-level minimum)
acceptance: taxonomy至少2层且节点有说明

title: Build chapter skeleton from taxonomy [NO PROSE]
acceptance: chapter_skeleton.yml 为 retrieval-informed 章节骨架；每章含 id/title/rationale/seed_topics/target_h3_count；无占位/无省略号

title: Bind papers to chapters before H3 decomposition [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每章生成 primary/support 论文绑定与 coverage_count；section_binding_report.md 含 PASS/BLOCKED/REROUTE；无占位/无省略号

title: Build section briefs from chapter layer [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每章生成 brief（section_rationale/contrast_lens/must_cover/target_h3_count/subsection_seeds/blocking_gaps）；无占位/无省略号

title: Derive stable outline from chapter skeleton + section briefs
acceptance: outline由 section-first 层派生，含章节+小节，且每小节至少3个bullet

title: Map papers to each subsection
acceptance: 每小节映射数满足 queries.md:per_subsection（course_paper=6；survey/deep=28；覆盖率=100%）；避免少数论文跨小节过度复用（除非 truly cross-cutting）

title: Planner pass: coverage report + outline state (NO PROSE)
acceptance: coverage_report.md 含 per-subsection 表；outline_state.jsonl 至少1条记录，且记录 structure_phase/h3_status/approval_status/reroute_target/retry_budget_remaining；REROUTE_STATE.json 存在且与最新 outline_state 一致；无占位/无省略号

title: Draft C2 review summary (scope+section skeleton+outline)
acceptance: DECISIONS含C2 review摘要（覆盖 chapter skeleton + section bindings + stable outline + reroute state）

title: HUMAN approve C2 (scope+section skeleton+outline)
acceptance: 勾选 DECISIONS.md 的 Approve C2

title: Download PDFs + extract fulltext snippets
acceptance: fulltext_index非空；若 evidence_mode=fulltext 则需若干篇提取成功（strict 会拦截接近0）

title: Write paper notes + evidence bank for core set
acceptance: core_set覆盖率100%；标注 evidence_level；evidence_bank 密度满足 profile（course_paper>=4 items/纸；survey/deep>=7 items/纸）；避免大量重复模板泄漏到下游

title: Build subsection briefs (writing cards) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每个H3生成写作意图卡（scope_rule/rq/thesis/axes/clusters；paragraph_plan：course_paper=6，survey/deep=10；每段含 argument_role+connector_to_prev+connector_phrase）；无省略号/无占位符

title: Build chapter briefs (H2 writing cards) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每个含H3的H2生成 chapter brief（synthesis_mode+synthesis_preview+throughline/key_contrasts/lead_paragraph_plan）；无占位/无省略号

title: Verify citations and build ref.bib
acceptance: ref.bib每条都有verified.jsonl记录（url+date+title）

title: Bind evidence IDs to subsections (evidence plan) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每个H3满足 profile：course_paper evidence_ids>=6、mapped_bibkeys>=6、bibkeys>=6、distinct papers>=4；survey/deep evidence_ids>=24、mapped_bibkeys>=28、bibkeys>=20；evidence_ids 可在 evidence_bank 中定位；无占位/无省略号

title: Build evidence packs per subsection [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每个H3证据包满足 profile：course_paper snippets>=6/comparisons>=3/evaluation>=3/limitations>=3；survey 12/4/5/5；deep 14/6/6/6；blocking_missing为空；引用key可验证；无占位/无省略号

title: Define table schemas (index+appendix; evidence-first) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: table_schema.md 定义 Index+Appendix 两层表格（course_paper 总计>=2；survey/deep>=4），并明确每列证据来源；无占位/无省略号

title: Fill index tables from evidence packs (citations in rows) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: outline/tables_index.md 为内部索引表（course_paper>=1；survey/deep>=2；每行含 citations；无占位/无省略号；避免长段落单元格；不直接进入终稿）

title: Curate reader-facing Appendix tables (publishable) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: outline/tables_appendix.md 为面向读者的可发表表格（course_paper>=1；survey/deep>=2；无 headings；每行含 citations；无占位/无省略号）；TABLES_APPENDIX_REPORT.md 为 PASS

title: Build per-subsection anchor sheet (evidence → write hooks) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每个H3 anchors 满足 profile（course_paper>=6；survey>=10；deep>=12），包含 numbers/benchmarks/failures/protocol context，且每条含 citations+pointers；无占位/无省略号

title: Normalize schema across C3/C4 JSONL artifacts (NO PROSE)
acceptance: SCHEMA_NORMALIZATION_REPORT.md Status: PASS；关键 JSONL 记录补齐 section_id/section_title；citations 列表统一为 raw bibkey（无 @ 前缀）。

title: Build writer context packs (C4→C5 bridge) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 每个H3 writer pack 满足 profile：course_paper plan=6/anchors>=6/comparisons>=3/limitations>=2/mapped>=6；survey/deep plan=10 且使用各自高密度阈值；must_use 非空；无占位/无省略号

title: Evidence self-loop TODO (prewrite routing)
acceptance: EVIDENCE_SELFLOOP_TODO.md 写出 Status + 每个缺口小节的最小上游修复路径（回到 C2/C3/C4 哪个 skill）；若存在 evidence_drafts.blocking_missing 则此 unit 必须 BLOCKED（先补证据再写作）

title: Rewrite claim-evidence matrix from evidence packs [NO PROSE]
acceptance: 矩阵以 evidence packs 为准：每小节含 `- Claim:` 且 `Evidence:`>=2；无占位/无模板句/无省略号

title: Write front matter (Abstract/Intro/Related/Discussion/Conclusion)
acceptance: FRONT_MATTER_REPORT.md Status: PASS；全部 front matter 文件存在且无占位符；course_paper Intro cites>=6/paras>=3、Related cites>=8/paras>=3；survey/deep 使用 pipeline quality_contract 的高密度阈值；methodology note 仅出现一次；无 pipeline 术语泄漏

title: Write H2 chapter leads (coherence bridge)
acceptance: CHAPTER_LEADS_REPORT.md Status: PASS；每个含H3的H2都有 `sections/S<sec_id>_lead.md`（body-only，无 headings），2–3段且引用嵌入（>=2 cites）；无 slash-list 轴标签/无占位符

title: Write H3 subsection bodies (argument moves; body-only)
acceptance: 为每个H3写 `sections/S<sub_id>.md`（body-only，无 heading；满足写作合同：thesis early + concrete A-vs-B contrasts + protocol-aware evaluation anchor + cross-paper synthesis + limitation；顺序可变，禁止固定段落宏），写完后创建 marker `sections/h3_bodies.refined.ok`（空文件即可）作为完成信号；然后 rerun 本 unit 生成更新后的 sections_manifest.jsonl

title: Writer self-loop (sections quality gate + actionable TODO)
acceptance: WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md Status: PASS；只修失败的 sections/*.md；满足 draft_profile 的小节深度/引用密度/论证骨架；引用范围符合 evidence_bindings；无旁白模板/无占位符

title: Style harmonizer (de-slot openers; keep citations fixed)
acceptance: 若 WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md 有 Style Smells，则必须完成去口癖/去模板化改写（含开头句型去模板）；仅允许改写被点名的 sections/*.md，禁止新增事实与 citation keys；完成后创建 marker `sections/style_harmonized.refined.ok`。

title: Opener variator (de-template H3 openers; keep citations fixed)
acceptance: 按 WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md 中 Style Smells 点名文件完成开头去模板化（禁用“This subsection.../In this subsection.../overview narration”）；不得新增事实或改 citation keys；创建 marker `sections/opener_varied.refined.ok`。

title: Logic polish H3 sections (thesis + connectors)
acceptance: SECTION_LOGIC_REPORT.md 为 PASS；每个 H3 第一段含 thesis/takeaway（结论先行；对齐 briefs thesis；避免 ""This subsection ..."" 旁白模板句）；逻辑关系要清晰但不靠句首连接词堆叠（鼓励 subject-first + mid-sentence glue；连接词统计仅作提示，不作为硬阈值 gate）；不新增/不修改 citation keys；无占位符

title: Compact H3 paragraphs to the active profile budget
acceptance: PARAGRAPH_CURATION_REPORT.md Status: PASS；只处理 H3；每个 H3 收敛到 profile 段落预算（course_paper:5-7 / survey:10-12 / deep:11-13）；仅合并相邻段落并保持 citation blocks 顺序和成员不变；报告记录 before/after；创建 marker

title: Numeric hygiene sweep before final snapshot (same-sentence eval context)
acceptance: EVAL_ANCHOR_REPORT.md 存在且非空；Files checked>0；保留数字/性能断言的 H3 段落需具备同句最小评测上下文（task/metric/constraint 至少两类且不缺 metric），否则降级为定性表述；不新增/不删除/不移动 citation keys

title: Snapshot final section arguments and consistency contract
acceptance: ARGUMENT_SELFLOOP_TODO.md Status: PASS；summaries 覆盖当前全部 H3 且每段 moves 合法；Consistency Contract 存在；sections_manifest 的 bytes+sha256 与最终 H3 内容一致；snapshot 为中间态且不进入终稿

title: Weave optional transitions (no new facts) [NO PROSE]
acceptance: transitions.md 生成可审阅的可选过渡句（无新事实/无引用）；仅在 workspace 明确创建 insertion marker 时进入终稿

title: Merge final section snapshot into a single draft
acceptance: DRAFT.md 由最终 sections snapshot + Appendix tables 组装；transitions 仅按 insertion marker 注入；MERGE_REPORT.md 为 PASS（无缺失小节、stale manifest 或表格）

title: Post-merge reader-voice gate
acceptance: POST_MERGE_VOICE_REPORT.md Status: PASS；默认只检查实际 DRAFT；仅在 insertion marker 启用时把 transitions 视为注入来源；若 FAIL 按报告路由回实际来源

title: Citation budget report (boost unique cites, NO NEW FACTS)
acceptance: 生成每个H3的 in-scope citation budget（优先未被全局使用的 bibkeys），写入 output/CITATION_BUDGET_REPORT.md；不修改内容；不引入新引用key

title: Inject in-scope citations from budget (NO NEW FACTS)
acceptance: 如果 budget report Gap=0 则 no-op 且 PASS；否则只注入报告建议的 in-scope keys，不得引入新事实/数字；注入后达到 profile policy target（course_paper hard>=24/recommended>=32；survey hard>=150/recommended>=165）；写 CITATION_INJECTION_REPORT.md (Status: PASS)

title: Polish draft (de-template + coherence)
acceptance: 去除套话/ellipsis/模板句；保持引用不变；禁止连续引用块与同块重复 key；H3 句中引用比例满足 profile（course_paper>=20%；survey/deep>=30%）；通过 draft 质量门槛

title: Global consistency review (terminology + RQ closure)
acceptance: GLOBAL_REVIEW.md 完整（Status: PASS）且 draft 通过质量门槛；术语一致、结论回扣主线

title: Audit + regression checks (PASS/FAIL)
acceptance: AUDIT_REPORT.md 状态为 PASS；无省略号/占位符；引用key健康；通过去模板化与引用形态硬门；H3 句中引用比例满足 profile（course_paper>=20%；survey/deep>=30%）

title: Scaffold LaTeX project (main.tex)
acceptance: latex/main.tex 存在且引用 citations/ref.bib；应无 markdown 残留（如 **、[@...]、##）

title: Compile LaTeX to PDF + build report
acceptance: main.pdf 编译成功且可读（无未定义引用/引用key）；PDF 页数 >= 8；build report 记录页数与 warnings 摘要

title: Contract audit (artifact contract + target_artifacts)
acceptance: CONTRACT_REPORT.md 状态为 PASS（且无 DONE 输出缺失；target_artifacts 缺失=0）
